name: Ghost Walker Post
summary: Ghost Walker Post is a modest tauren settlement situated in the heart of Desolace right beside the ancient Kodo Graveyard. Far more exposed to regional dangers than Shadowprey Village on the western coast, it serves as a frontline Horde staging ground against centaur clans and the Burning Blade.

sections.title: A Watch on the Wastes
sections.body: Perched on the dusty flats of central Desolace, Ghost Walker Post provides the Horde with an austere foothold in a hostile territory. Unlike the sheltered coastal fishing haven of Shadowprey Village, this post directly faces roaming centaur marauders and demon-worshiping cultists of the Burning Blade. Facilities are spartan, offering only the bare essentials for travelers, with no inn or flight master in sight. Despite the harsh conditions, a garrison of tauren and an orcish detachment sent by Warchief Thrall keep vigilant watch over the badlands.

sections.title: Guardians of the Graveyard
sections.body: Led by the tauren shaman Gurda Wildmane, the spiritual heart of the outpost is closely entwined with the neighboring Kodo Graveyard. Shamans stationed here tend to the dying beasts that wander in to perish, helping ease them into the next life and communing with their lingering spirits. Between spiritual communion and constant military readiness, the defenders of the post honor the ancient bond between the tauren and the mighty kodo amid the ashes of Desolace.

faq.answer: It is a small, rugged Horde outpost located in central Desolace, established primarily by tauren with support from an orcish garrison.
The post is led by Gurda Wildmane, a tauren shaman who tends to the camp's defenses and the neighboring Kodo Graveyard.

faq.q: Why is the post located near the Kodo Graveyard?
faq.answer: Gurda Wildmane and fellow tauren shamans reside here to help ease dying kodo into their next lives and to commune with the spirits of the fallen beasts.

faq.q: What enemies does Ghost Walker Post fight?
faq.answer: The garrison wages constant war against the local hostile centaur tribes and the sinister forces of the Burning Blade operating across Desolace.

faq.q: Can I get a flight path or rest at an inn here?
faq.answer: No. The outpost provides only the bare necessities for adventurers and lacks both an innkeeper and a wind rider master. Travelers must seek transport elsewhere, such as Shadowprey Village.

faq.q: How does it compare to Shadowprey Village?
faq.answer: While Shadowprey Village is a protected troll enclave on the western coast, Ghost Walker Post is inland, heavily exposed to surrounding threats, and focused on frontier defense and spiritual duties.

angles.text: The camp reflects the tauren's deep sacred duty to the natural world, standing as guardians beside the ancestral resting grounds of the kodo.
Under Gurda Wildmane, the shamans here perform the sacred work of speaking with ancient spirits and easing dying beasts into the spirit world.
